name: Earned Reverence
label: Quest
description: Earned Reverence: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I must know, friend. When you look directly into the eyes of the enemy, do you see fear? Do they now cower in your presence? They must realize that they are defeated!
You have earned reverence among the Guard. Present your insignia!

clips.title: Completion
paras: When we first met, I would have never guessed that a hero was in the making. Carry on, soldier!
